rationale: For an accessibility-first tool aimed at the visually impaired, contrast and clarity are paramount. Archetype 4 provides the structural rigidity and stark contrast needed. We are employing a 'Swiss Brutalist' approach: prioritizing high legibility, massive typography, thick focus rings, and zero ambiguity.

typography.rationale: Cabinet Grotesk provides a distinctive, fresh voice that breaks the 'SaaS default' mold, while Atkinson Hyperlegible is specifically designed by the Braille Institute for maximum legibility and character distinction.
typography.installation_instructions: Load 'Cabinet Grotesk' via Fontshare or local assets. Load 'Atkinson Hyperlegible' via Google Fonts.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-12) to prevent accidental misclicks. Control Room Grid for functional areas.
spacing_and_layout.glassmorphism_rules: Use glassmorphism strictly with high-contrast borders (border-white/20) and backdrop-saturate-150. Ensure text inside glass containers maintains a 7:1 contrast ratio (WCAG AAA).

accessibility_rules_CRITICAL.focus_indicators: ALL interactive elements must have a thick focus state: `focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-[#FFEA00] focus-visible:ring-offset-4 focus-visible:ring-offset-black`
accessibility_rules_CRITICAL.aria: Use ARIA landmarks extensively (main, nav, region). Ensure all buttons have `aria-label`.
accessibility_rules_CRITICAL.keyboard_nav: The entire app MUST be navigable via Tab key without mouse traps.
accessibility_rules_CRITICAL.voice_output: Provide auditory feedback for major actions (e.g., 'Image Uploaded').
accessibility_rules_CRITICAL.contrast_ratio: Minimum 7:1 for all text in high-contrast mode, minimum 4.5:1 in standard dark mode.
accessibility_rules_CRITICAL.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid (e.g., data-testid='upload-image-button').

components.buttons: Large touch targets (min-h-[56px]). Primary buttons use pure #FFEA00 background with #000000 text. Hover states elevate with sharp drop shadows, no soft blurs.
components.upload_zone: Massive target area (h-64+), dashed white border (2px), distinctly changes on drag-over (bg-white/10 + solid yellow border).
components.caption_display: Dedicated massive card, using `text-3xl` or larger, with a quick 'Copy' and 'Play Audio' floating action bar tightly coupled to the text.
components.sidebar: Fixed accessibility sidebar or floating FAB that opens a drawer. Must contain toggle for High Contrast, Font Size (A+/A-), Dark/Light mode, and Voice Guidance.
components.icons: Use `lucide-react` with a minimum size of 24px and explicit stroke-width of 2.5 for clarity.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Hard background color changes, no subtle opacity shifts. Text must remain pure white/black.
interactions_and_motion.audio_controls: Play, Pause, Resume, Stop buttons must be instantly accessible next to the generated text, never hidden behind dropdowns.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow WCAG AAA contrast ratios (7:1).
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Atkinson Hyperlegible' for body. Update Tailwind config.
Ensure the Text-to-Speech API handles long captions smoothly with Play/Pause.
Bind 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles).
Implement High Contrast Toggle that sets app background to #000000, text to #FFFFFF, and focus rings to #FFFF00.
